'''Haunted Skulls (dangerous)''' are a flying [[Monsters|enemy]] found in [[the Mines]] after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] or during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep]] quest. During the [[Desert Festival]], they may spawn in the [[Skull Cavern]] if a certain [[Desert Festival#Skull Cavern|Calico Statue effect]] is activated.

==Behavior==
They behave identically to their weaker counterpart the [[Haunted Skull]]. They may fly away from the player and change the direction of attack.

==Strategy==
The best weapon may be a regular sword swing (not a club or dagger), since its angle is large.  If possible, move in a direction contrary to the Skull so a mob is all on one side of the player, and swing at them all at once.
